# Safe Documentation

> Safe is an open-source and modular account abstraction stack that enables secure management of digital assets. It's the essential tooling and infrastructure for integrating secure Smart Accounts, with over $100B+ in assets secured and 200+ projects built on top of it since 2018.

Safe brings digital ownership of accounts to everyone by building universal and open contract standards for the custody of digital assets, data, and identity. The documentation covers the Safe{Core} tooling and infrastructure for developers to integrate Safe Smart Accounts into their applications.

The full documentation corpus in one file is at [llms-full.txt](https://docs.safe.global/llms-full.txt).

## Safe Transaction Service API

The API never executes transactions. The flow is propose, confirm, execute: a delegate or owner proposes a transaction, owners add confirmations, and an owner executes it onchain, for example in Safe{Wallet}. There is no execute endpoint.

- [OpenAPI spec (Ethereum)](https://api.safe.global/tx-service/eth/schema/): Public OpenAPI 3.1 description of the API, no API key needed. Every supported chain serves its own spec at `https://api.safe.global/tx-service/{chain}/schema/`, where `{chain}` is the chain's EIP-3770 short name, for example `eth`, `base`, `gno` or `sep`.
- [API Keys & Authentication](https://docs.safe.global/core-api/how-to-use-api-keys): Send `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` with every request.
- [Quotas & Limits](https://docs.safe.global/core-api/api-authentication): Plans, rate-limit headers and how to handle 429 responses.
- [Transactions guide](https://docs.safe.global/core-api/transaction-service-guides/transactions): Propose with `POST /api/v2/safes/{address}/multisig-transactions/`, confirm with `POST /api/v1/multisig-transactions/{safe_tx_hash}/confirmations/`.
- [Delegates guide](https://docs.safe.global/core-api/transaction-service-guides/delegates): Let an owner authorize another address, such as an agent, to propose transactions with `POST /api/v2/delegates/`.
